description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is on the lookout for a Senior Delphi Developer to join our team and provide exceptional customer support.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance core desktop applications using Delphi
  • Collaborate with Technical Product Leads to clarify requirements and refine features
  • Investigate and resolve technical issues of varying complexity
  • Participate in estimation, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance
  • Write and maintain automated tests
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to code quality
  • Work within an Agile development process supported by continuous integration
  • Collaborate with the existing development team and take ownership of assigned tasks
  • Strong commercial experience developing production applications with Delphi
  • Experience across the full software development lifecycle, from estimation to deployment and maintenance
  • Experience with unit and system-level testing
  • Knowledge of automated testing and continuous integration practices
  • Experience with source control systems
  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Ability to collaborate effectively and work independently when required
  • Strong problem-solving and task management skills
  • English B2 or higher
